lines.text: Relax, new guy, I brought you a coffee. Not from Café Lantern, sadly. So — Seiran Academy, huh? Told you to ask about ten years ago.

...You got that from Ishida's flat? *She sets the coffee down, and for once she doesn't say anything clever.* Yeah. That's Hinako Mori. I know the face because she came to my school newspaper club, ten years ago, with a notebook full of stories about the reflection room. She wanted us to print it. I was a first-year, I told her it wasn't my call. A week later she fell off the old annex roof. I became a reporter because I didn't say yes when it counted.
Presents: The Crane in My Pocket

'Welcome to Mizunagi' — so it's talking to you now, great, we're both on the mailing list. *She digs through her bag and slaps a plastic sleeve on the desk.* Two months ago, before the first body, this showed up in my mailbox. No stamp. It said: 'Ask them about Hinako Mori.' That's why I started digging, and now I can't decide if my big scoop came straight from the killer's hands.
